name: manual_172778
claim: Preserve the UTF-8 BOM for PowerShell 5.1 scripts when editing them with a file editor; if the BOM is stripped, PowerShell 5.1 reads the file as the system ANSI codepage and fails to parse Unicode content such as em-dashes or Greek letters.

decisions.notes: While rehabilitating start.ps1 we saw the file stop parsing after an editor rewrite removed the BOM; re-adding the BOM restored execution. Tracked Python files should stay UTF-8 without BOM, but PowerShell 5.1 launchers are the exception.
